name: GitHub PR Authoring
purpose: Author pull requests with structured descriptions, evidence links, and breaking change disclosures.
inputs: Branch diff, base branch, and target issue
Local test, lint, and security command output
Public contract impact, migration notes, and reviewer owners
outputs: Draft or ready pull request with one coherent objective
Description with technical changes, evidence, and linked issues
Reviewer routing, breaking-change note, and merge-readiness check
stop_conditions: The pull request is focused, evidence-backed, compatible, and ready for the requested reviewers
